grounding.from: Ratehub lists the best high-ratio (insured) 5-year fixed rate in Canada at 4.34%. Wowa gives the same 4.34% as the lowest insured 5-year fixed rate.

grounding.states: insured lowest rate is up 25 bps from 30 days ago
grounding.from: It says this is 25 bps higher than 30 days ago and 14 bps higher than 7 days ago.
Wowa puts the lowest conventional (uninsurable) 5-year fixed rate at 4.44%.

grounding.states: uninsured figure is not confirmed, a second Wowa figure is 4.64%
grounding.from: That is a different figure from Wowa's own later line quoting 4.64% for uninsurable mortgages, so its numbers don't agree with each other.
Ratehub's table (updated October 13) shows a Big 6 bank at 4.54%
Rates are climbing in October 2026, after all six of the largest banks raised select fixed rates since early September.

value.answer: Depends if the mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or not. Insured: the lowest I can find is 4.34%, and that's up about 25 bps from a month ago. Uninsured: the lowest is 4.44%, but one source gives 4.64%, so I can't confirm that one. The big banks are running about 4.54% to 4.74%. Rates have been climbing since early September. Is yours insured or uninsured?
